title: Укус бешеной лошади  (Bitten by a Mad Horse)

segments.t: Philanthropist Alyokhin storms downstairs after Mikhail's runaway pony wandered into his hotel room and bit him! Refusing to discuss any money before getting a rabies shot, he leaves Eleonora furious, while Katya helps Denis cover up his Tokyo story.
У тебя в номере лошади кусаются!
Мы ведь о деньгах не поговорили.
Давай выпьем за Катю с Никитой.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Forgive me, please, dear friend.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'forgive' and finishing on 'friend'.
У тебя в номере лошади кусаются!
'Horses bite in your hotel room!' The grammar packs 'at' and 'bite' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Tell me, is this a hotel or a stable?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'say' and finishing on 'stable'. Eleonora answers right away.
Мы ведь о деньгах не поговорили.
'We did not even talk about the money.' Eleonora brings out the contrast between 'we' and 'after all' in a few short words.
'First I will get checked for rabies.' The grammar packs 'at first' and 'I will get checked' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'There is a mad horse in my hotel!' The grammar packs 'my' and 'horse' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Denis answers right away.
Давай выпьем за Катю с Никитой.
'Let us drink to Katya and Nikita.' The meaning hinges on 'come on' working together with 'Nikita' in spoken Russian.
'They are a very beautiful couple, after all.' In Russian, the idea of 'they' flows naturally into 'couple' without extra filler words.
'We are drinking to our young couple.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'we' and finishing on 'young'. Denis answers right away.
'They canceled the flight to Tokyo today.' Denis brings out the contrast between 'flight' and 'Tokyo' in a few short words.
'The plane is not flying because of bad weather.' In Russian, the idea of 'plane' flows naturally into 'bad weather' without extra filler words.

'The weather there is terrible, a strong typhoon.' Katya brings out the contrast between 'weather' and 'there' in a few short words. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.

Мы ведь о деньгах не поговорили.
Давай выпьем за Катю с Никитой.
With Alyokhin gone and a mad horse loose in the corridors, Timur finishes counting the votes in the kitchen election. Until next time!
